title: The Shift
description: Anna, an agency worker, takes her dog for a morning walk before doing her shopping. Searching through the discounted items, Anna wanders through the supermarket trying to find the most affordable necessities. As her groceries edge towards the checkout, her agency calls; she has lost her shift.
music: but when their feelings of loneliness threaten to overwhelm them
Jak invites a new hookup into this sanctuary – opening up to all the pleasure
embarrassment and self-discovery that comes with queer intimacy.
